SELECT EDR.업체코드 AS ENTRPS_CODE , EDR.NO AS SN , EDR.착지업체 AS DLVY_ENTRPS , EDR.출고사업장 AS DLIVY_BPLC , (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_DE_CECK , (CASE WHEN CM.배송일 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_SUN , (CASE WHEN CM.배송월 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_MON , (CASE WHEN CM.배송화 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_TUE , (CASE WHEN CM.배송수 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_WEN , (CASE WHEN CM.배송목 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_THUR , (CASE WHEN CM.배송금 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_FRI , (CASE WHEN CM.배송토 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_SAT , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.본_주소) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_ADDRESS , CM.최소주문량 AS MUMM_ORDER_QY
, (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN ISNULL(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_1 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_1) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_1
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_2 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_2) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_2
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_3 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_3) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_3
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_4 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_4) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_4
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_5 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_5) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_5
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_6 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_6) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_6
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_7 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_7) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_7 END, DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()))
ELSE DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()) END) AS DEADLINE
mapper.sql: FROM 거래처MASTER CM JOIN 업체배송지등록 EDR WITH(NOLOCK) ON (CM.등록사업장 = EDR.출고사업장 AND CM.거래처코드 = EDR.착지업체) , (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 1, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_1 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 2, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_2 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 3, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_3 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 4, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_4 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 5, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_5 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 6, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_6 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 7, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_7 ) AS DATE_TAB
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT WB.착지업체 AS W_ALOCENTRPS , (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WB.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WB.출고사업장) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_NM
ORDER BY WB.착지업체
mapper.sql: FROM 웹장바구니 WB JOIN 거래처MASTER CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WB.착지업체 = CM.거래처코드 AND WB.출고사업장 = CM.등록사업장) JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WB.출고사업장 = IC.사업장 AND WB.품목코드 = IC.품목코드)

WHERE 1=1 AND WB.거래처코드 = #{bcncCode} AND WB.납기일자 > #{searchDtFrom} AND WB.납기일자 <= #{searchDtTo} AND 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 웹주문접수 WO2 WHERE WB.거래처코드 = WO2.거래처코드 AND WB.일자 = WO2.장바구니일자 AND WB.일련번호 = WO2.장바구니번호 AND WO2.접수삭제 = 'N' )
AND IC.품목명 LIKE UPPER('%'+ #{searchItemNm} +'%')
mapper.select:
SELECT WB.일자 AS W_DE , WB.일련번호 AS W_SN , WB.단가 AS W_UNTPC , WB.단가사업장 AS W_UNIT_BPLC , WB.납기일자 AS W_DEDT , WB.단가단위 AS W_UNTPCUNIT , WB.단가단위문자 AS W_UNIT_CHRCTR , WB.수량 AS W_QUANTITY , WB.그룹수량 AS W_GRP_QY , WB.낱개수량 AS W_PIECE_QY , WB.중량 AS W_WT , WB.공급가액 AS W_SPLPCAM , WB.부가세 AS W_VAT , WB.착지업체 AS W_ALOCENTRPS , WB.출고사업장 AS W_DLIVY_BPLC , WB.합계금액 AS W_SUMAMOUNT , WB.주문비고 AS W_NOTE , WB.선택여부 AS W_CHOISE_AT
, SUM(WB.합계금액) OVER (PARTITION BY WB.납기일자) AS GRP_SUMAM , COUNT(WB.납기일자) OVER (PARTITION BY WB.납기일자) AS CO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WB.납기일자 ORDER BY WB.납기일자, WB.일련번호) AS GRP_DTNUMBER
, (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WB.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WB.출고사업장) AS CM_ENTRPSNM , RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , RTRIM(IC.단위) AS IC_UNIT
, (CASE IC.단위중량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위중량 END) AS IC_UNITWT , (CASE IC.포장단위 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.포장단위 END) AS IC_PACKNGUNIT
, (CASE IC.단위당수량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위당수량 END) AS IC_UNITQY , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , UPC.단가단위 AS UPC_UNTPCUNIT , UPC.신단가 AS UPC_NEWUNITPC , CONVERT(VARCHAR(1),UPC.부가세포함유무) AS UPC_VATINCLSAT
, DBO.웹_재고중량_함수(WB.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목코드), 'B', WB.일자, 0) AS INVNTRY_QY , DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), WB.납기일자) AS DATE_DIFF
ORDER BY WB.납기일자, WB.일련번호 --, CM.상호
mapper.sql:
FROM 웹장바구니 WB JOIN 단가변동 UPC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (WB.단가사업장 = UPC.사업장 AND WB.거래처코드 = UPC.거래처코드 AND WB.품목코드 = UPC.품목코드 AND UPC.변경일자 = (SELECT MAX(UPC2.변경일자) FROM 단가변동 UPC2 WHERE UPC.사업장 = UPC2.사업장 AND UPC.품목코드 = UPC2.품목코드 AND UPC.거래처코드 = UPC2.거래처코드 AND UPC2.변경일자 <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),getdate(),112)) )
JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (UPC.사업장 = IC.사업장 AND UPC.품목코드 = IC.품목코드)
